items:

sections.text:
Low 
Pressure Heater out of Operation

items: Check the low pressure heater completely drainage .
Check the air service for cleaning is available
Dismantling the cover of the low pressure heater to check tubes leakage
Cleaning the tubes by flexible shaft (first cleaning)
Cleaning the tubes by compressed air about 6 bar (sec. cleaning)
Cleaning the tubes by compressed water about 6 bar (finally cleaning)

Filling the Low pressure Heater condensate side with the demi-water and 
 determine the leakage tubes and blind them by copper plugs
Recording the number of tubes which blind them not more than 5 ٪.
Assembling the cover of the low pressure heater
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it is needed).
Check glands of valves for leaking.
Check flanges for leaking.

Check the casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed) and repack 
 isolated against temperature looses.

sections.text: Return Regenerative Air Heater into Service

items:

 the low pressure heater 
 by coordination with the shift engineer.

Ensure that 
 low pressure heater 
 is 
 OK and record the readings of clearance, temp., vibration, ... etc, and 
 compare with ref. values.
